normal:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: corrected pixel-art background master for a Mega Drive fighting game; PNG review ONLY, not a game screenshot.
Input image 1 is the edit target, a complete logical 512x512 Namek background. Images 2 and 3 are supporting crops pointing out the broken joins, not elements to insert.
Edit ONLY the narrow terrain junction band at logical y=340..400. Keep the entire sky, clouds, Guru house, main cliff tops, composition, camera perspective, and foreground below y400 unchanged. The color palette is APPROVED: preserve its neutral beige/grey rocks, ivory house, blue grass, green sky exactly; no red/orange shift and no extra colors.
Correct the floating/cut-off crescent-shaped ridges copied repeatedly across the foreground under the two main mesas. Remove those curved detached ribs and redraw that junction as continuous flat blue grassy ground with restrained existing neutral dirt patches. The two actual large mesas MUST remain in their existing positions and dimensions: the smaller one on the left and the big Guru-house mesa on the right. Their cliff faces should meet and rest on the ground with clear continuous silhouettes and modest contact shadows, not abruptly cut into horizontal blocks or duplicated over another hill. Retain the existing thin blue-canopy trees and make their trunks continuous down to the ground.
Match the existing fine one-logical-pixel art detail, not a coarse grid. Logical resolution512x512; if producing a larger raster, use an exact integer pixel-art enlargement. Crisp pixel clusters, limited existing palette, no blur, no gradients, no random grain/dithering, no painted/HD texture. Keep the grass texture restrained and reusable, avoiding individually noisy tiles. No new props, no HUD, no characters, no text, no extra buildings, no new mountains.
The goal is an anatomically coherent terrain drawing with no clipped rock fragments, no repeated mirror-symmetrical scraps and no ambiguous floating forms, while preserving everything the user liked.
aldea:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: full pixel-art Namek devastated-village background PNG for review, not ROM integration.
Image1 is the APPROVED corrected normal Namek master. Use it as the geometry/edit target. Image2 is the old devastated map, ONLY a mood and ruined-building reference; DO NOT copy its broken foreground or cropped curved ribs. Image3 shows a specific bad floating/half-cut ruined house resting incorrectly on a rock; eliminate that problem.
Create the devastated variant of image1. Preserve exactly the overall layout, the two mesas, mountain contours and their clean contact with the flat ground, tree positions, Guru-house silhouette/size/location, and the corrected continuous blue grassy floor. Keep its neutral grey/beige stone, ivory architecture and blue grass color families; no rusty reds or orange. Keep the ivory Guru house intact in the exact same place on the main mesa.
Change the green sky to the smoky grey overcast mood of image2, retaining the cloud layout. Add the ruined village clearly in the distance at the foot of the mesas, where the old map had ruins: a small broken ivory dome/wall on the LEFT flat ground, inset far enough from the image edge to see the entire visible ruin and its base; a second restrained rubble cluster on the RIGHT flat ground. These are distant, modest structures, not giant foreground objects. Every ruined wall/roof must meet the actual flat grassy/dirt surface with a clear base and subtle contact shadow. Do not put a house on top of a separate stone/hill or float a roof over a cropped rock. Smoke may rise from these existing ruins, not from Guru's house. Preserve ample clear foreground fighting space.
Same fine crisp pixel-art density as approved image1, no coarse enlarging, no blurry painting, no arbitrary changes elsewhere. No detached crescent cliffs, copied/mirrored rock scraps, cut-off trunks, floating objects, scenery pasted across a straight line, extra mountains, HUD, fighters, text, frames or panel comparisons.
Single complete square panorama with the same framing as image1. This is a careful variant of an approved base, not a redesign.
porunga:
Use case: compositing.
Asset: complete square pixel-art Namek background, review master PNG, NOT yet a ROM asset.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED corrected normal background and is the edit target. Input image 2 is the earlier Porunga variant used ONLY to reference the dragon and night mood, not its defective curved terrain ribs.
Create the Porunga invocation variant of image 1. Keep the entire landscape of image 1: both mesas, cliff bases meeting continuous flat blue grassy ground, all trees, foreground texture, and the small ivory Guru house in exactly the same position and scale. Preserve the muted grey/beige cliff colors and blue grassy foreground. Do not alter the house or introduce ruins.
Change only the sky to the navy/green summoning night atmosphere of image 2 and add the small distant green Porunga hovering above the left mesa, between the mesas, at the same position/proportion as image 2. Porunga has a horned head, muscular arms and curled serpentine lower body, a readable complete silhouette in fine pixel art. He should appear behind the trees/landscape, no pasted rectangular edge, no extra lightning, no animation frames.
Sky uses restrained dark navy and green clouds; no discontinuous horizontal sky cutoff. Retain fine crisp pixel-art detail density compatible in appearance with image1; don't enlarge logical pixels, don't blur or add grain/dither.
Invariants: keep approved composition, architecture, mesa size and silhouettes, ground contacts, muted rocks, ivory house, blue grass. No detached curved/crescent cliff scraps, no repeated outcrop collars, floating buildings, new foreground props or duplicated dragon.
No HUD, characters, text, borders, comparisons. One complete square image with the same framing as input1.
